description: FREE local completeness and safety check for ordinary goods dispatched from DE/AT to the US. Requires product, material, intended-use, origin, value and explicit regulated-attribute answers. No product URL is accepted or fetched. Returns an opaque job ID and recovery secret for the paid guard.

brand.description: Product brand if known; leave empty when it is unknown.

country_of_origin.description: Valid ISO-3166 manufacturing origin, not dispatch country

customs_value_usd.description: Declared customs value in US dollars as a decimal string, not cents; provide at most two decimal places.

destination_country.description: Destination jurisdiction; this guard currently accepts only US.

dispatch_country.description: Country from which the goods will be dispatched; this service supports DE or AT, not the manufacturing origin.

hts_code.description: Optional buyer-declared 6, 8 or 10 digit HTS code

importer_use.description: How the importer will use the goods: personal, commercial resale, business use, gift or sample.

intended_use.description: The actual intended use of the goods by the US importer.

material_or_composition.description: Known materials or ingredient composition of the goods; state uncertainty rather than inventing a composition.

merchant_forwarding_policy.description: Whether the merchant permits forwarding these goods: allowed, prohibited or unknown; do not infer permission from checkout availability.

model.description: Product model or model identifier if known; leave empty when it is unknown.

product_description.description: Factual description of the product, its construction and features, sufficient to assess its intended use and risk attributes.

product_name.description: Specific product name; identify the item rather than a shop or product URL.

quantity.description: Number of product units in the shipment, from 1 to 10000.

risk_answers.description: Explicit answers for every listed regulated-product attribute. Use unknown when evidence is missing; do not silently treat it as no.

alcohol_or_tobacco.description: Whether the shipment includes alcohol or tobacco: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

battery.description: Whether the shipment includes battery or battery-containing goods: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

chemical_or_hazmat.description: Whether the shipment includes chemicals or hazardous materials: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

childrens_product.description: Whether the shipment includes products intended for children: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

cosmetic.description: Whether the shipment includes cosmetics: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

counterfeit_or_unlicensed_replica.description: Whether the shipment includes counterfeit goods or unlicensed replicas: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

drug_or_medical_device.description: Whether the shipment includes drugs or medical devices: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

food_or_supplement.description: Whether the shipment includes food or dietary supplements: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

plant_seed_or_animal_product.description: Whether the shipment includes plants, seeds or animal products: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

radio_transmitter.description: Whether the shipment includes radio transmitters: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

weapon_or_weapon_part.description: Whether the shipment includes weapons or weapon parts: yes, no or unknown. Use unknown when not established.

name: prepare_us_import_readiness

outputSchema.description: Structured result contract for prepare_us_import_readiness. A success satisfies the documented success branch. A domain or tool error includes error and is not a successful settlement; unpaid x402 requirements are carried by the transport wrapper.

charged.description: When present on an error, false means the failed result is uncharged.

price.description: No payment is required for this tool.

settled.description: When present on an error, false means no settlement occurred.
